objective: Bring 8 pieces of Tough Wolf Meat to Eagan Peltskinner outside Northshire Abbey.

description: I hate those nasty timber wolves!  But I sure like eating wolf steaks...  Bring me tough wolf meat and I will exchange it for something you'll find useful.
Tough wolf meat is gathered from hunting the timber wolves and young wolves wandering the Northshire countryside.
progress: Hey <name>. I'm getting hungry...did you get that tough wolf meat?
completion: You've been busy! I can't wait to cook up that wolf meat...
I have some things here you want - take your pick!
